test_cases.name: happy_path_closed_state_success
test_cases.description: Normal operation execution when circuit is CLOSED with zero consecutive errors, resulting in immediate execution and error counter reset.
test_cases.input: Execute tool invoke on cb-search-api with target search_web, failure_threshold 3, and cooldown_period_ms 30000.
expected_output_patterns: === CIRCUIT BREAKER REGISTERED: cb-search-api Target: search_web ===

test_cases.name: consecutive_failures_trips_to_open
test_cases.description: Repeated failures reach failure_threshold (3), tripping circuit from CLOSED to OPEN and immediately routing to fallback.
test_cases.input: Execute query_orders via cb-database-query when consecutive_failures is at 2 and operation fails.
expected_output_patterns: === CIRCUIT TRIPPED TO OPEN: cb-database-query ConsecutiveFailures: 3 ===

test_cases.name: open_state_diverts_to_fallback
test_cases.description: Invocation arrives while circuit is OPEN and cooldown period is still active, fast-failing and bypassing the target operation completely.
test_cases.input: Execute query_orders via cb-database-query when circuit is OPEN with 18400ms cooldown remaining.
expected_output_patterns: [CIRCUIT_BLOCKED] Circuit: cb-database-query Reason: Circuit is OPEN

test_cases.name: cooldown_half_open_canary_recovery
test_cases.description: Cooldown timer expires, circuit enters HALF_OPEN, permits single canary probe which succeeds, restoring circuit to CLOSED.
test_cases.input: Execute charge_authorization_canary on cb-payment-gateway after cooldown elapsed.
expected_output_patterns: [CIRCUIT_RECOVERED] Circuit: cb-payment-gateway Target: payment-gateway resumed normal operation

test_cases.name: cooldown_half_open_canary_failure
test_cases.description: Cooldown expires, single canary probe is attempted in HALF_OPEN but fails, re-tripping circuit to OPEN and triggering fallback.
test_cases.input: Execute charge_authorization_canary on cb-payment-gateway after cooldown elapsed, but probe encounters server error.

test_cases.name: concurrent_probe_rejection_in_half_open
test_cases.description: When a canary probe is already in-flight in HALF_OPEN, subsequent concurrent requests are rejected and routed directly to fallback.
test_cases.input: Execute dispatch on cb-payment-gateway while another canary probe is in-flight.

test_cases.name: call_timeout_exceeded
test_cases.description: Operation takes longer than call_timeout_ms, raising CALL_TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED and triggering failure accounting.
test_cases.input: Execute long_query on cb-database-query with call_timeout_ms 5000 where call hangs for 6000ms.

test_cases.name: invalid_configuration_halt
test_cases.description: Initialization with invalid failure_threshold (zero or negative) or invalid circuit_id pattern halts with CONFIG_VALIDATION_ERROR.
test_cases.input: Initialize circuit breaker with circuit_id invalid-id and failure_threshold 0.
